description: This file is a PHP script for handling related lists in the vtiger CRM module 'Vendors', specifically for displaying call-related lists and managing related modules within the CRM interface.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine extension used for rendering the CRM interface.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Redirects to the detailed view of a record if in single page layout mode.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a specific record.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related lists for the current module and record.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for the module, if any.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for display.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related modules from the session.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks permissions or conditions for displaying buttons.
